title: How Long Will My Language Model Run? A Benchmark for Pre-Execution Runtime Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.26875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Researchers submitting deep learning jobs to shared GPU clusters need runtime estimates to request time limits, choose hardware, and budget compute. Large language models (LLMs) offer a tempting shortcut: describe the job and ask. We introduce PreRun, a benchmark for predicting deep learning training and inference runtime from information available before execution. PreRun contains 801 training and 1,884 inference records of language and vision models collected on a GPU cluster, paired with workload configurations and explicitly defined timing targets. It also includes 64 text-generation configurations measured under standardized conditions, each in three separate program launches. We compare three LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Claude Opus 5.5) with regression baselines and evaluate analytical estimates on a supported forward-pass subset. On 16 held-out generation configurations, the open-weight LLMs underestimate latency by 90-99%

translated_title: 我的语言模型要运行多久？一个执行前运行时预测基准
translated_abstract: 研究人员在向共享GPU集群提交深度学习任务时，需要运行时间估计来申请时限、选择硬件和预算计算资源。大语言模型提供了一个诱人的捷径：描述任务并直接询问。我们提出了PreRun，这是一个基于执行前可用信息来预测深度学习训练和推理运行时间的基准。PreRun包含在GPU集群上收集的801条训练记录和1,884条语言与视觉模型推理记录，并与工作负载配置和明确定义的计时目标配对。它还包括在标准化条件下测量的64个文本生成配置，每个配置分别进行了三次独立的程序启动。我们将三个大语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-OSS-120B和Claude Opus 5.5）与回归基线进行比较，并在支持的前向传播子集上评估解析估计。在16个留出的生成配置上，开源权重的大语言模型将延迟低估了90-99%。
tldr: 本文提出PreRun基准，用于在执行前预测深度学习训练与推理的运行时间，包含数千条GPU集群实测记录，实验发现大语言模型对运行延迟的估计严重偏低（开源模型低估90-99%）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PreRun, a benchmark for predicting deep learning training and inference runtime from pre-execution information, revealing that LLMs severely underestimate latency (by 90-99%) compared to regression baselines.
